desc:
Welcome to Soccer Jumping! ⚽️
Squat with football players to soar higher into the sky!

How to Play:
🏋️‍♂️ Squat to build up your soccer strength
💸 Jump higher to earn money for new soccer player 
🚀 Reach different layers of the sky and show your ultimate skill

You literally jump even when you’re offline! 💤
